# Problem 1 – Factor Analysis

```{r}
r <- matrix(c(
  1.00,0.44,0.41,0.29,0.33,0.25,
  0.44,1.00,0.35,0.35,0.32,0.33,
  0.41,0.35,1.00,0.16,0.19,0.18,
  0.29,0.35,0.16,1.00,0.59,0.47,
  0.33,0.32,0.19,0.59,1.00,0.46,
  0.25,0.33,0.18,0.47,0.46,1.00
), nrow=6, byrow=TRUE)

colnames(r) <- rownames(r) <- c("French","English","History","Arithmetic","Algebra","Geometry")

set.seed(123)
efa2 <- factanal(covmat=r, factors=2)
efa2

efa3 <- factanal(covmat=r, factors=3)
efa3

efa2_norot <- factanal(covmat=r, factors=2, rotation="none")
efa2_norot
```

# Problem 2 – Gene Clustering

```{r}
genes <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EricBrownTTU/ISQS6350/main/geneexpression.csv",
  header=FALSE
)

sample_cor <- cor(t(genes))
dist_cor <- as.dist(1 - sample_cor)

hc_avg <- hclust(dist_cor, method="average")
plot(hc_avg)

clusters_avg <- cutree(hc_avg, k=2)
group <- ifelse(1:nrow(genes) <= 20, "Healthy", "Diseased")
table(group, clusters_avg)

hc_comp <- hclust(dist_cor, method="complete")
plot(hc_comp)
clusters_comp <- cutree(hc_comp, 2)
table(group, clusters_comp)

hc_single <- hclust(dist_cor, method="single")
plot(hc_single)
clusters_single <- cutree(hc_single, 2)
table(group, clusters_single)

mean_diff <- apply(genes, 2, function(g){
  abs(mean(g[group=="Healthy"]) - mean(g[group=="Diseased"]))
})

top_genes <- order(mean_diff, decreasing=TRUE)[1:10]
top_genes
mean_diff[top_genes]
```

# Problem 3 – Protein Data Clustering

```{r}
urlremote <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/"
pathGithub <- "EricBrownTTU/ISQS6350/main/"
filename <- "protein.csv"

protein <- read.csv(paste0(urlremote, pathGithub, filename), row.names="Country")
protein <- protein[,1:9]

protein_scaled <- scale(protein)

set.seed(123)
max_k <- 10
wss <- sapply(1:max_k, function(k){
  kmeans(protein_scaled, centers=k, nstart=25)$tot.withinss
})

plot(1:max_k, wss, type="b")

k_opt <- 3
km_protein <- kmeans(protein_scaled, centers=k_opt, nstart=25)
protein$Cluster <- factor(km_protein$cluster)
split(rownames(protein), protein$Cluster)

cluster_means <- aggregate(protein,
                           by=list(Cluster=protein$Cluster),
                           FUN=mean)
cluster_means

mc_protein <- Mclust(protein_scaled)
summary(mc_protein)
plot(mc_protein, what="classification")

protein$MC_Cluster <- mc_protein$classification
split(rownames(protein), protein$MC_Cluster)

plot(mc_protein, what="uncertainty", dimens=c(1,9))
```

# Problem 4 – Association Rules

```{r}
courses <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EricBrownTTU/ISQS6350/main/Coursetopics.csv",
  header=TRUE
)

courses_trans <- as(as.matrix(courses), "transactions")
rules <- apriori(courses_trans,
                 parameter=list(supp=0.10, conf=0.50, minlen=2))

length(rules)
summary(rules)

rules_sorted <- sort(rules, by="lift", decreasing=TRUE)
inspect(head(rules_sorted, 1))

lhs_intro_reg <- subset(rules_sorted,
                        lhs %pin% "Intro" & lhs %pin% "Regression")

inspect(lhs_intro_reg)
```
